name: hello-check
job: Validate that a checklist JSON file passes its declared gates: parse it, resolve each gate to its checker, run all checkers, and emit a fail-closed verdict.

inScope: Parsing a checklist JSON file and validating its structure
Resolving declared gates to their checkers and running them
Per-gate pass/fail/error reporting with a fail-closed overall verdict
outOfScope: Editing or fixing the checklist file
Reporting a gate as passing without a resolvable checker

outputs: Per-gate results (passed, failed, or error) with one-line reasons
Verdict receipt per outcome-receipt.schema.json when requested

data: The checklist JSON file to validate

failureSemantics: Fail closed: an unparseable file, an invalid structure, or any unresolved or failing gate yields an overall FAIL verdict that names the offending gate.

outcome.observable: A verdict report listing every declared gate with passed, failed, or error and the overall PASS/FAIL verdict
